name: c-questionnaire-1
title: Guided workspace setup
description: Three required questions in a card, with progress, navigation and a summary on submit.

name: c-questionnaire-2
title: Multi-select answers
description: A checkbox question that accepts several answers, with a live count and a chip summary.

name: c-questionnaire-3
title: A written answer beside the choices
description: A text input sitting with the fixed choices, so an answer can be typed instead of picked.

name: c-questionnaire-4
title: Segmented progress with step labels
description: A custom progress bar built from the progress render state, over a four question flow.

name: c-questionnaire-5
title: An optional question with skip
description: A question the visitor may skip on purpose, with the skipped state carried into the summary.

name: c-questionnaire-6
title: A rule that sends you back
description: A cross-question rule checked on submit, returning the flow to the question that broke it.

name: c-questionnaire-7
title: A branch that appears when it applies
description: A question that only joins the flow after an earlier answer, with avatars, reset and a summary.
